history.change: Rebuilt Spain canonical progress after completed REVE national pass; corrected denominator semantics and initialized first-pass decisions from existing tariff seed.

First-pass batch: promoted Ajuntament de Calvia from current official municipal tariff; classified Gran Canaria partial using current official network evidence and exact ULPGC subset while refusing to generalize older tariff bands.

First-pass batch advanced 14 additional REVE labels. Promoted ACCIONA Recarga, Aduriz Energia and Santa Maria del Cami from official tariff authorities; kept Inca, Bunyola, Allego and Anargo active for deterministic station/operator mapping; set aside seven low-evidence municipal/site cases without blocking the queue.

First-pass batch advanced 10 additional REVE labels. Promoted Baix Ebre Innova at 0.30 EUR/kWh from current official Consell/Baix Ebre page; kept Atenco/Canaluz and Felanitx active because deterministic app/MELIB paths exist but exact public price was not exposed; set aside seven low-evidence municipal/dealer/site operators without blocking the queue.

First-pass batch advanced 11 additional REVE labels. Kept BSM/Endolla, Bonpreu and Electra active for deterministic station pricing; set aside Barter, Beasain, Las Ramblas, Carrefour and Chargevite after reasonable first-pass search; excluded ChargePoint as a platform whose station owners set tariffs; deduplicated Charging Together Norte SL and Charging Together SL to Iberdrola | bp pulse.
